answer: Each identity must sign with a quill minted that epoch: the k-th quill costs k x 10 units of ivory-bonded stake, locked for the full epoch, and any quill signing twice is burned with its stake. One fake identity pays 10 units; N fakes pay 10 x N(N+1)/2, a quadratic bill no pooling can split, since each quill is bound to one yarrow audit trail sampling one identity per epoch.
